name: Dr. Jekyll
note: Polygons in the rest pose (A1) pixels. Gothic sheets (the Horseman's style). Transylvania's seat 2, one half of the seat (Hyde is the other). The master is the rest pose's OWN head (jekyll_face/jekyll_master.png). Every pose but rest a whole-figure frame with its own drawn head, placed by the bottom-left corner of its drawn felt. His phial of the draught stands on the felt by his right hand: part of that forearm's piece at rest and a props box in every frame but `phial` (B6), where he holds it up.

what.A1: Rest: forearms on the table's edge, hands apart, the phial by his right hand
what.A2: Peek: right hand cupped low over the felt
what.A3: Check: two fingers tap the felt
what.A4: Call: right hand pushes forward along the felt
what.A5: Bet: right hand pushed well forward, measured
what.A6: Fold: a courteous push of the hand toward the middle
what.B1: All in: both hands push forward together
what.B2: Show: right hand turns palm up
what.B3: Big win: both hands raised, a delighted, slightly sheepish smile (`win_big`)
what.B4: His right hand turned to Hyde's for a moment; he pulls his cuff over it
what.B5: Rubs his hands together as if cold (decoy for B4)
what.B6: Holds the phial up to the light
what.C1: Taps the phial with a fingernail, not looking at it (decoy for B6)
what.C2: Dabs his brow with a white handkerchief
what.C3: Consults his gold pocket watch (decoy for C2)
what.C5: A courteous, kindly smile at the table
what.C6: Arrive: sitting down, straightening his coat, composed but pale
what.D2: Facing a big bet: fingertips together, grave
what.D3: Lost a pot: a polite, rueful nod
what.D4: Crushing loss: his head in one hand, the other closed round the phial (`lose_big`)
what.D5: Heads up: leaning in on both forearms
what.D6: A gentle laugh, a hand on his chest

rest.what: his right forearm, cuff and hand, and the phial by it
his left forearm, cuff and hand
